description: Generated legacy Flashtalking /imp tags. Official HTML5 SDK fallback and publisher guide establish positional tag syntax; official Innovid Tag Assistant 1.1.5 establishes these servedby aliases. Missing tuple values are template completeness advisories. Signed payloads and unpublished event transports remain unvalidated.
